note.text: Most AI roadmaps still stop at the screen: a chatbot, a dashboard, a recommendation someone else has to act on. The bigger shift is AI that touches inventory, machinery, and logistics directly, closing the loop between decision and physical outcome without a human translating output into action. Leaders chasing better insights are solving yesterday's problem; the harder build is AI that moves a robotic arm, reroutes a truck, or halts a line on its own judgment. Treat AI as an analytics layer and a competitor will ship it as an operating layer instead.
